course_summary:
ISEN 660 / CHEN 660, SENG 660 | Risk Engineering | Fall 2025
Instructor: Neil Diaz Martinez | nodiaz@tamu.edu
Meets: TR | 08:00AM-09:15AM | ZACH 160
Grading: Quizzes, homework, assignments [20%], Unit 1 Evaluation: Systems Engineering [20%], Unit 2 Evaluation: Risk Management [20%], Unit 3 Evaluation: Probabilistic Risk Assessment - PRA [10%], Unit 4 Evaluation: Reliability [30%] — A: 90-100, B: 80-90, C: 70-80, D: 60-70, F: <60
Topics: MBSE, SySML, ISO 31000:2018, IEC 31010:2019, Probabilistic Risk Assessment (PRA), Elements of Component Reliability, System Reliability Analysis, Reliability of Repairable Systems, intricate engineering systems, complex, interconnected systems, industrial facilities, qualitative approaches, quantitative approaches, Systems Engineering discipline, international standards, Risk Management, risk analysis, identification of potential hazards, assessment of potential hazards, mitigation strategies, reliability, engineering systems, industry practices, fundamental concepts, techniques, applications, exercises, case studies, foundations, processes, guidelines, assessment techniques, fundamentals, use case, engineering components, additional topics
Tools: Canvas, Eclipse Papyrus
Prerequisites: Graduate classification
